component.name: MyLongboxDB Assistant
component.summary: Fill in comic book details for MyLongboxDB

description.p: MyLongboxDB Assistant looks up the details of comic books from a cover photo or a series and issue number, using a Claude model from Anthropic with your own API key. You review every field it found before anything is saved, and the results are written as a MyLongboxDB full export for you to import. If you add your own copy of the Grand Comics Database's data, lookups check it before they search the web.
The Assistant never opens your MyLongboxDB collection, connects only to Anthropic's API, and keeps your API key encrypted with a passphrase, or does not store it at all.
Cleaner imports, larger photos, and nothing lost by closing.

ul.li: Every creator, character, and team goes into the export as one name, so MyLongboxDB's search finds each on its own
A book typed without its volume joins the series the rest of its export names, rather than starting a series of its own
Cover photos are larger, and Add Books names each Front and Back
On opening, the app says how many looked-up books are waiting for review
Closing the app while books are being looked up asks first

description.p: Drag photos in, and one name per entry in the export.

ul.li: Drag cover photos onto the Photos tab, or one onto a book for its back cover
Characters and credits a lookup gave as one line are now one name each, so MyLongboxDB lists and finds each on its own
The photo list keeps your place when you combine, swap, or remove photos
The review page no longer puts the same note on every character

description.p: Your own copy of the Grand Comics Database, grades for your copies, and an easier review.

ul.li: Add your own copy of the Grand Comics Database's data dump, and lookups check it before they search the web
Give each copy its grade, who graded it, and a grading company's certificate number, as MyLongboxDB takes them
Mark each book reviewed, see how sure the lookup is beside every value, and edit an issue's notes as a whole paragraph
A series' volume goes into the export only when you tick it, so two issues of one series no longer import as two series
An About window shows the version you are running

description.p: The first release: look up comic books from cover photos or typed lines, review them, and export them for MyLongboxDB.

ul.li: Add books by cover photo, iPhone HEIC included, or by typing a series and issue number, and turn, straighten, or crop a photo first
A Claude model from Anthropic, called with your own API key, reads the cover and looks the book up on the web, in the comics wikis, and in what it knows, saying where each detail came from
Values follow your collection's conventions, and anything doubtful, judged, or shared waits for your tick
Review every value with its source, then export the books, with your photos as their covers, as a MyLongboxDB full export
Your key is kept encrypted with a passphrase, or not at all, and photos are sent with no location or camera details
